forms.difference: Form I perfect; it states the completed act of desiring or preferring, contrasting with the current imperative.
forms.relationship: Form I perfect of the ر غ ب root, the verbal base of the current command.
forms.provenance: Codex-authored after review of Quranic Arabic Corpus ر غ ب evidence and standard Form I morphology.

forms.difference: Form I imperfect; it presents desire or preference as ongoing rather than as a direct command.
forms.relationship: The imperfect counterpart of رَغِبَ in the ر غ ب family, attested repeatedly in the Qur'an.
forms.provenance: Codex-authored after review of Quranic Arabic Corpus occurrences 2:130, 4:127 and 9:120.

forms.difference: Verbal noun/related noun; it names the desire or hope rather than expressing it as a verb.
forms.relationship: A genuine noun in the ر غ ب family, related to the Qur'anic رَغَبًا.
forms.provenance: Codex-authored after review of Quranic Arabic Corpus occurrence 21:90:15 and approved Arabic lexical evidence.

forms.difference: Active participle, masculine singular; it names one who desires or turns toward something rather than issuing the command.
forms.relationship: The active participle of رَغِبَ, attested in Qur'anic usage as رَاغِبُونَ.
forms.provenance: Codex-authored after review of Quranic Arabic Corpus occurrences 9:59, 19:46 and 68:32 and standard Form I active-participle morphology.

lesson:94:8:3.takeaway: The root ر غ ب remains connected to “direct your longing”.

provenance: Canonical evidence and aligned Quranic Arabic Corpus morphology were checked for the رغب root family.
